description: A React-based web application for a reading list, including component definitions, state management, and DOM mounting logic.

classes.name: AppHeader
classes.description: Displays the React version and the number of books in the reading list.

classes.name: ColorButton
classes.description: A button component styled with a color and enabled/disabled status.

classes.name: ButtonGrid
classes.description: Creates a grid of ColorButton components with different colors and states.

classes.name: NewBook
classes.description: Provides input for adding a new book to the reading list.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main React component managing the state of the reading list and rendering child components.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Handles input events to update the new book's name.

methods.name: onNewBook
methods.description: Adds a new book to the state's book list.
